scenario.basicRingAttack.description: Player One attacks Player Two with a ring and direct-damage spell.
scenario.elementDuelStart.description: Electric Adept and Fire Adept have tied speed and level, then resolve the starting player with an element duel.
scenario.lowerLevelStart.description: Two heroes have tied speed, so the lower-level hero starts.
scenario.skillShowcase.description: Development battle with ready monsters for testing every current monster skill.
scenario.spellSelfTargeting.description: Player One uses a direct-damage spell on their own hero.
scenario.summonAndTaunt.description: Player One summons a Taunt monster and Player Two targets it.
spell.arcRelay.description: Deal 2 electric damage to the targeted monster, then deal 1 electric damage to one random other monster controlled by the same player.
spell.arcRelay.name: Arc Relay
spell.bloodflame.description: Deal 2 fire damage to the targeted allied monster. If it survives, it permanently gains +2 damage for the rest of the battle.
spell.bloodflame.name: Bloodflame
spell.burnI.description: Apply BURN to the targeted monster. BURN deals 3 fire damage at the start of that monster controller's next turn, then expires.
spell.burnI.name: Burn I
spell.burnII.description: Apply BURN to the targeted monster. BURN deals 3 fire damage at the start of each of its controller's next 2 turns.
spell.burnII.name: Burn II
spell.burnIII.description: Apply BURN to the targeted monster. BURN deals 3 fire damage at the start of each of its controller's next 3 turns.
spell.burnIII.name: Burn III
spell.carbonize.description: Apply BURN for 1 turn to every monster currently in play, including allied monsters. Each Burn deals 3 fire damage at the start of that monster controller's next turn.
spell.carbonize.name: Carbonize
spell.chainExplosion.description: Destroy the targeted allied monster, then deal fire damage equal to its current damage to every enemy monster.
spell.chainExplosion.name: Chain Explosion
spell.cleanse.description: Remove all temporary positive and negative statuses from the targeted monster. Do not remove its natural or spell-granted skill.
spell.cleanse.name: Cleanse
spell.cooldownOnKill.description: For the rest of the battle, whenever the supported ring kills a monster with ring-and-gem damage, reduce that ring's current cooldown by 1.
spell.cooldownOnKill.name: Cooldown on Kill
spell.copy.description: Create a duplicate of the targeted monster with the same current damage, current and maximum health, base cooldown, element and skill. The copy enters with cooldown 1.
spell.copy.name: Copy
spell.crystalSkin.description: Give the targeted allied monster a temporary SHIELD until the start of its controller's next turn. If it already has an active Shield, the spell has no additional effect.
spell.crystalSkin.name: Crystal Skin
spell.damageOnKill.description: For the rest of the battle, whenever the supported ring kills a monster with its ring-and-gem damage, that ring gains +2 damage.
spell.damageOnKill.name: Damage on Kill
spell.deepFreezing.description: Apply FREEZE for 1 owner turn to every monster currently in play, allied and enemy.
spell.deepFreezing.name: Deep Freezing
spell.destruction.description: Destroy every monster currently in play, allied and enemy.
spell.destruction.name: Destruction
spell.devotion.description: Destroy the targeted allied monster. A random other allied monster permanently gains damage equal to the destroyed monster's current damage for the rest of the battle.
spell.devotion.name: Devotion
spell.electroshock.description: Apply SHOCK for 1 owner turn to every monster currently in play, allied and enemy.
spell.electroshock.name: Electroshock
spell.energyOnKill.description: For the rest of the battle, whenever the supported ring kills a monster with ring-and-gem damage, restore 1 energy to its hero during the current turn.
spell.energyOnKill.name: Energy on Kill
spell.freezeI.description: Apply FREEZE to the targeted monster for 1 owner turn. A frozen monster cannot attack and cannot provide TAUNT.
spell.freezeI.name: Freeze I
spell.freezeII.description: Apply FREEZE to the targeted monster for 2 owner turns.
spell.freezeII.name: Freeze II
spell.freezeIII.description: Apply FREEZE to the targeted monster for 3 owner turns.
spell.freezeIII.name: Freeze III
spell.funeralBrand.description: Mark the targeted enemy monster for this action only. If it is destroyed during this complete ring action, deal damage equal to its current damage to its controlling hero.
spell.funeralBrand.name: Funeral Brand
spell.giftMultiHit.description: Give MULTIHIT to the targeted monster for the rest of the battle. If it already has MULTIHIT, the spell has no additional effect.
spell.giftMultiHit.name: Gift: MultiHit
spell.giftPierce.description: Give PIERCE to the targeted monster for the rest of the battle. If it already has PIERCE, the spell resolves with no additional effect.
spell.giftPierce.name: Gift: Pierce
spell.giftRage.description: Give RAGE to the targeted monster for the rest of the battle. If it already has RAGE, the spell has no additional effect.
spell.giftRage.name: Gift: Rage
spell.giftShield.description: Give SHIELD to the targeted monster for the rest of the battle. If it already has the SHIELD skill, the spell has no additional effect.
spell.giftShield.name: Gift: Shield
spell.giftTaunt.description: Give TAUNT to the targeted monster for the rest of the battle. If it already has TAUNT, the spell has no additional effect.
spell.giftTaunt.name: Gift: Taunt
spell.lastBreath.description: Until the end of the current turn, if the targeted allied monster is destroyed, it performs one final attack against a random legal enemy target before being removed.
spell.lastBreath.name: Last Breath
spell.pierceLegacy.description: If the targeted enemy monster is destroyed by the ring-and-gem damage of this action, deal the overkill damage to its controlling hero.
spell.pierceLegacy.name: Pierce
spell.quickPulse.description: Set the targeted allied monster's current cooldown to 0.
spell.quickPulse.name: Quick Pulse
spell.refresh.description: Reduce the current cooldown of one random allied ring that is currently on cooldown by 1.
spell.refresh.name: Refresh
spell.rimeLock.description: Increase the targeted monster's current cooldown by 1, up to its resolved cooldown value.
spell.rimeLock.name: Rime Lock
spell.sacrifice.description: Destroy the targeted allied monster. Then destroy one random enemy monster.
spell.sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
spell.shockI.description: Apply SHOCK to the targeted monster for 1 owner turn. A shocked monster cannot attack but can still use TAUNT.
spell.shockI.name: Shock I
spell.shockII.description: Apply SHOCK to the targeted monster for 2 owner turns.
spell.shockII.name: Shock II
spell.shockIII.description: Apply SHOCK to the targeted monster for 3 owner turns.
spell.shockIII.name: Shock III
spell.shortCircuit.description: Set the targeted enemy monster's current cooldown to its full resolved cooldown value.
spell.shortCircuit.name: Short Circuit
spell.stompI.description: Deal 2 ice damage to every enemy monster.
spell.stompI.name: Stomp I
spell.stompII.description: Deal 3 ice damage to every monster in play except monsters controlled by the spell caster.
spell.stompII.name: Stomp II
spell.stompIII.description: Deal 4 ice damage to every enemy monster.
spell.stompIII.name: Stomp III
spell.transmute.description: Transform the targeted monster into a 2 damage, 2 health Electric monster with cooldown 1 and no skill.
spell.transmute.name: Transmute
spell.zerakaiProtocol.description: Create a temporary duplicate of the targeted allied monster with the same current damage, element and base cooldown, but 1 maximum health and no skill. It enters with cooldown 0 and is destroyed at the end of the current turn.
spell.zerakaiProtocol.name: Zerakai Protocol
spell.zeroInterval.description: Target an allied monster. Set the current cooldown of every allied monster to 0.
spell.zeroInterval.name: Zero Interval
